verdict.rationale: Vercel's own pricing docs say Sandbox usage is metered across several dimensions, so billing is usage-based rather than flat. The pack never states per-second granularity or that only actively used compute is billed. Timeouts and Spend Management are cost controls, not evidence of billing granularity. Missing for 10: documented per-second billing granularity, explicit active-compute-only (e.g., idle-excluded) charging, specific rates or units, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses

citations.quote: Vercel Sandbox usage is metered across several dimensions.
